## Pull request overview

This PR reduces Vercel CI build memory/time by simplifying the console build pipeline and skipping memory-heavy Vite plugins in CI, while also addressing TypeScript typing issues exposed by the new build approach (workspace src aliases) and improving package export compatibility.

**Changes:**
- Adjust console Vite/Vercel build configuration to skip compression/visualizer plugins in CI and remove the turbo prebuild step.
- Fix/extend TypeScript types used by dashboard/grid/detail plugins (e.g., widget table flags, I18n label handling).
- Add `"default"` export conditions to multiple workspace packages to improve resolver compatibility.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/vite.config.ts | Skips compression/visualizer in CI and centralizes workspace `src/` aliases for consistent resolution. |
| apps/console/vercel.json | Simplifies Vercel build command (removes turbo step, sets heap size/env vars). |
| packages/types/src/complex.ts | Extends `DashboardWidgetSchema` with `searchable`/`pagination` flags. |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Adds I18nLabel handling for column headers. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Tightens typing for `effectiveRelated` memo result. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts | Extends `isObjectProvider` type guard shape to include `filter`. |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/WidgetConfigPanel.tsx | Adds explicit typing for normalized config memo. |
| packages/auth/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/cli/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/collaboration/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/core/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/i18n/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition (including `./locales/*`). |
| packages/mobile/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/permissions/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/react/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
| packages/tenant/package.json | Adds `"default"` export condition. |
</details>

`DashboardWidgetSchema` gained `searchable`/`pagination`, but the corresponding Zod validators in `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` (both `DashboardWidgetSchema` and `DashboardWidgetConfigSchema`) don't include these keys. Because Zod `object()` strips unknown properties by default, validating/parsing dashboard configs can silently drop these new flags. Please extend the Zod schemas (and add/adjust a unit test in `packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-config.test.ts` to cover them).

`buildCommand` invokes `vite build` directly. Outside of a package-script runner, `node_modules/.bin` may not be on PATH (common on CI), which can cause `vite: command not found`. To make the command robust, use `pnpm exec vite build` (or `pnpm vite build`) instead of calling `vite` directly.
```suggestion
  "buildCommand": "pnpm msw:init && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 VITE_BASE_PATH=/ VITE_USE_MOCK_SERVER=true pnpm exec vite build",
```
